home.intro: You help build the energy transition, with real impact, real colleagues, and the freedom to choose your own path.
home.kaart1Titel: We dare to say what we stand for
home.kaart1Tekst: No detours, no vague talk. We communicate with conviction, and show what works through real stories instead of big claims.
home.kaart2Tekst: No two days are the same. You get the room to try, learn, sometimes fail, and above all grow, surrounded by people who help you along the way.
home.kaart3Tekst: What you do matters, but who you are matters just as much. You work with colleagues who support you and truly listen.
home.stat3Tekst: One shared ambition: accelerating the clean mobility revolution

overOns.intro: OG Clean Fuels delivers sustainable fuel solutions to transport and logistics, working every day on a cleaner sector.
overOns.kaart1Tekst: We believe in doing, not talking. Every project has a clear goal and a measurable result.
overOns.kaart2Tekst: The energy transition never stands still, and neither do we. We constantly look for what can be better and cleaner.
overOns.kaart3Tekst: We build on data and experience, not assumptions. That way we make choices that customers and colleagues can rely on.
overOns.sectie2Tekst1: Zero-emission zones, stricter European regulation, and an emissions trading system that keeps making pollution more expensive: decarbonizing transport is no longer a choice, it's a necessity. OG Clean Fuels already helps carriers switch today to Bio-CNG, Bio-LNG, HVO100, hydrogen and electric, instead of waiting for a "maybe" future.
overOns.sectie2Tekst2: That's not just our message to customers. It's the reason there's always something happening here: new fuel stations, new technology, new customers who want to decarbonize just as much as we do.
overOns.quote: We don't wait for the switch to be flipped. We make sure it's already there, ready to fuel up.
overOns.sectie3Intro: For us, impact doesn't stop at the pump. We support initiatives that, like us, look beyond the short term.
overOns.sponsoringTekst: We support ambitious athletes taking big steps in their sport, just as we do in the energy transition.
overOns.goedeDoelenTekst: Caring for the world also means caring for the people who live in it. We structurally support the Beatrix Children's Hospital.
overOns.sportTekst: Sport connects people and drives development. We also help sports clubs become greener.

werkenBijOg.metaDescription: No bureaucracy, but real responsibility from day one. Discover what it's like to work at OG Clean Fuels: our culture, what to expect, and what we offer.
werkenBijOg.intro: At OG Clean Fuels, you sign up for a mission, not a job description. Freedom and responsibility included.
werkenBijOg.intro2Tekst1: No bureaucracy, no endless layers of approval. At OG you work in a flat organization where ideas hit the ground fast, whether it's a new fuel station, smarter planning, or a better way of working.
werkenBijOg.intro2Tekst2: You get the room to experiment, make mistakes and grow. We're growing fast, and you'll feel it: there's always a project, client or challenge that needs your approach.
werkenBijOg.statTekst: less CO₂ emissions at our customers. That's not just a number on a website, that's the result of the work you deliver here.
werkenBijOg.kaart1Tekst: You won't get a three-month onboarding track before you're allowed to do anything "real". You get a clear goal, a mentor, and the trust to just do it.
werkenBijOg.kaart2Tekst: Growth happens fast here, because we grow fast. New role, new region, new responsibility: if you can handle it, the path is open.
werkenBijOg.kaart3Tekst: Small enough to know each other by name, big enough to make an impact. Short lines to management, even when you're just starting out.
werkenBijOg.voordeel1Tekst: Fair pay, no guessing games afterwards.
werkenBijOg.voordeel2Tekst: Your commute shouldn't be a math problem.
werkenBijOg.voordeel4Tekst: Training and career growth are the norm, not the exception.
werkenBijOg.voordeel5Tekst: Fast decisions, no weeks-long approval processes.
werkenBijOg.voordeel6Tekst: You help decide what your work looks like.
werkenBijOg.quote1: What I appreciate most here? That I'm actually allowed to experiment. Nobody blinks if an idea doesn't work out.
werkenBijOg.quote2: You really feel here that you're part of something bigger than your own role. The mission lives everywhere.
werkenBijOg.quote3: Within a few months I had more responsibility than in three years at my previous job.
